name: Betrothal
overview: The Scriptures illustrate betrothal as a solemn and binding commitment that closely resembles marriage, evidenced by Jacob's dedicated service of seven years to earn Rachel's hand (Genesis 29:18-20). This period of waiting culminates in the formal union, marked by a celebratory feast and the consummation of the relationship (Genesis 29:21-23). Betrothal, therefore, serves as a quasi-marriage arrangement, emphasizing both commitment and anticipation within God's design for covenant relationships.
